name: ashby
description: Ashby-hosted startup job boards (jobs.ashbyhq.com/{org}): list a company's open roles with locations, compensation and apply links, browse its departments, read company info, and fetch full job details.

commands.name: list-jobs
commands.summary: List every open job on a company's Ashby board, with title, department, location, workplace/employment type, job URL and apply URL (public Job Postings API).

params.name: org
params.description: Company board slug, the path segment in jobs.ashbyhq.com/{org}, e.g. ramp, notion, linear

params.name: includeCompensation
params.description: Include salary/equity compensation data for each job

commands.name: get-job
commands.summary: Get one job posting's full details: title, department, teams, location(s), workplace/employment type, compensation tiers and HTML description.

bodyTemplate.query:
query ApiJobPosting($organizationHostedJobsPageName: String!, $jobPostingId: String!) {
  jobPosting(
    organizationHostedJobsPageName: $organizationHostedJobsPageName
    jobPostingId: $jobPostingId
  ) {
    id
    title
    departmentName
    departmentExternalName
    locationName
    locationAddress
    workplaceType
    employmentType
    descriptionHtml
    isListed
    isConfidential
    teamNames
    secondaryLocationNames
    compensationTierSummary
    compensationTiers {
      id
      title
      tierSummary
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}

commands.sample: {"id":"f564dcf9-9390-4a3f-896f-8047a5086040","title":"Mobile Engineer, Android","departmentName":"Engineering","locationName":"New York, NY (HQ)","secondaryLocationNames":["Remote (Canada)","San Francisco, CA","Remote (US)"],"workplaceType":"Hybrid","employmentType":"FullTime","compensationTierSummary":"$189K – $330K • Offers Equity"}

commands.name: list-teams
commands.summary: List a company's departments/teams (id, name, parentTeamId hierarchy) as used by the board's department filter.

commands.name: get-company
commands.summary: Get company info for a job board slug: name, organization id, public website, custom careers page URL and privacy policy URL.

bodyTemplate.query:
query ApiOrganizationFromHostedJobsPageName($organizationHostedJobsPageName: String!, $searchContext: OrganizationSearchContext) {
  organization: organizationFromHostedJobsPageName(
    organizationHostedJobsPageName: $organizationHostedJobsPageName
    searchContext: $searchContext
  ) {
    ...OrganizationParts
    __typename
  }
}

fragment OrganizationParts on Organization {
  organizationId
  name
  publicWebsite
  customJobsPageUrl
  hostedJobsPageSlug
  allowJobPostIndexing
  isDemoOrg
  theme {
    colors
    showJobFilters
    showLocationAddress
    showTeams
    showAutofillApplicationsBox
    logoWordmarkImageUrl
    logoSquareImageUrl
    applicationSubmittedSuccessMessage
    jobBoardTopDescriptionHtml
    jobBoardBottomDescriptionHtml
    jobPostingBackUrl
    __typename
  }
  appConfirmationTrackingPixelHtml
  recruitingPrivacyPolicyUrl
  activeFeatureFlags
  timezone
  candidateScheduleCancellationReasonRequirementStatus
  showCookieBanner
  __typename
}

notes: Every command needs a company board slug (the {org} in jobs.ashbyhq.com/{org}). There is no search across companies.
Boards return all jobs at once, with no paging or sorting. Filter by department, location, workplaceType (OnSite/Hybrid/Remote) or employmentType (FullTime etc.) on the client side.
Job page: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/{org}/{jobId}. Application form: append /application. list-jobs also returns jobUrl and applyUrl.
